dct_title_s: Plan showing relation between lines established by the Riparian Commissioners of the State of New Jersey and harbor lines Delaware River Trenton New Jersey recommended by Major Herbert Deakyne and approved by Acting Secretary of War
dct_description_sm: Map covers area from Bridge Street to Lalor Street.

Map shows various properties along Delaware River. Positions of federal, Warren, Union, Reed, and Landing Streets, Mott's Line and distances on Riparian Commissioners' line between Federal Street and Mott's Line determined from plan of survey of property of N.J. Steeland Iron Co.
